notes: BIG: preview now matches the final render exactly. Caption layout (which words go in each caption + line breaks + timing) is computed by ONE engine on the server (build_timeline) and the preview just draws it — no more drift between the on-screen preview and the burned render. Styling (colours, stroke, shadow, scrim, karaoke, animation) stays instant client-side; layout refreshes on a short debounce like the exact preview, with a local fallback for the demo/pre-transcription placeholder. Also in this build: default presets baked into the app (whole team always has the library); the beta Animation can't hide captions; the last caption no longer hangs to the clip end on the board/merged path; Export names captioned files with the _nSub suffix removed; Export/Import a style as .json to share; green Export button.
